description: Robustness of the allied network design (Section 10). Each variant changes one setting of the production configuration of scripts/30 ( 37 nodes with the EU-27 as one node; Upstream and Midstream; MILP via method = 'auto'; GDP-log portfolio caps on; w_edge = 0.5; demand_mode = 'mixed'; diversity_lambda = 0.78 ). Producer set = nodes with production share > 0 in a stage. Jaccard = |A and B| / |A or B| of the variant's and the production design's producer sets, per stage. reassigned = 0.5 * sum_p |x_alt - x_base| (share of the stage's production assigned to different nodes; 0 = identical shares, 1 = disjoint).

solver_comparison_no_caps.description: MILP (method auto) vs greedy, both without portfolio caps (identical eligible sets).

edges.description: Off-diagonal ordered node pairs (producer p != consumer c) of each stage. both = FS(c,p) and PO(p,c) observed (after the EU node's aggregation); fs_only / op_only = one component; neither = no observation (W = 0). mean_edge_weight_offdiag = unweighted mean of W over these pairs (zeros included). flow_weighted_edge_weight_offdiag = sum f W / sum f over the production design's flows between distinct nodes.

runtime.note: *_sec: wall-clock seconds; *_cpu_sec: CPU seconds of the R process (GLPK runs in-process), on a shared Windows workstation (R 4.4.1, GLPK via ompr/ROI) with other jobs running, so wall-clock times vary between runs. Stage times include building the ompr model. The design run excludes loading the inputs.
